provenance.source: development-split runs of this code base (scripts/10, 11, 20, 21, 22)
provenance.note: Values are transcribed from the reported runs, not recomputed during repository preparation. A full retraining run was not executed for this repository, so treat them as reference targets rather than as an independent reproduction.
provenance.sealed_holdout: not read; all numbers are development-set evidence

protocol.decoder: fixed-lag Viterbi, 3 frames, 0.6 s nominal wait
protocol.fold: leave one assembly object out; only that object's labelled frames are scored

main_run.volume_matched_note: the reported run scored 0.6854; this repository samples the five control seeds from a sorted episode list so the draw does not depend on PYTHONHASHSEED, which moves the mean by 0.0015

five_model_round.note: same folds, decoder and training budget; GRUctx and DualHead are not a strict single-variable ablation of each other

statistics.note: recomputed by scripts/22 from the evaluation file that yields 0.6717 / 0.7135. An earlier audit over a previous evaluation file reported 96 of 111 (86.5 %), W = 493 and p = 1.43e-14; those values do not reproduce from the final file.

known_limitations: development split only; the 37-episode sealed holdout was never read
single global seed; cross-seed robustness was not evaluated
the 17 object folds are correlated replications, not 17 independent tests
the gain is label-level: full-episode boundary F1 does not improve
the oracle is a conditional upper bound that requires the true parent action at every frame
GRUctx and DualHead differ in both where the action information enters and in the decision rule

independent_reproduction.what: scripts/00 to 02 then scripts/10 were re-run end to end on the full development split
independent_reproduction.exact_match_folds: 17 of 17 for SF, GRUctx, the shuffle control, the oracle and the visible-object reference (max |difference| 0.0 over 17 folds)
independent_reproduction.not_rerun: the five-model round (scripts/11) was executed on two of the seventeen folds; all five schemes matched the reported per-fold values exactly on both, the remaining fifteen folds were not re-run
